keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: Decision models
keywords.about: Compact decision models share control with LLMs and are benchmarked for robustness, speed and calibration across text and vision.

keywords.name: Robot manipulation
keywords.about: Manipulation policies learn from human videos, tactile grasping and residual action tokens, with bimanual data scaled without stereo cameras.

keywords.name: Diffusion models
keywords.about: Diffusion and video generators are made autoregressive, distilled and stabilized, while classifier-free guidance is re-examined information-theoretically.

keywords.name: Recursive self-improvement
keywords.about: Agents rewrite their own training loops, evolving scientific swarms and world models to improve without human supervision.

keywords.name: Long-horizon agentic RL
keywords.about: Agents in ALFWorld-style environments train with retrospective exploration, executable oracle continuations and self-distillation to survive long horizons.

keywords.name: LLM agent harnesses
keywords.about: Agents are wrapped in harnesses—scaffolding, tools and training loops—then benchmarked on computer-use and rule-reasoning tasks.

keywords.name: VLA models
keywords.about: Vision-language-action policies gain physical state transitions, spatial grounding benchmarks and joint world-action training.

keywords.name: Humanoid loco-manipulation
keywords.about: Humanoids learn whole-body dexterity and motion retargeting, pairing reactive visual control with MPC posture planning under unknown payloads.

keywords.name: RLVR
keywords.about: Verifiable-reward RL scales to longer rollouts and multiple rewards, with token-level credit assignment inside agent and GUI training.

keywords.name: On-policy distillation
keywords.about: Students distil RL-induced policy shifts from teachers using branching rollouts, multi-teacher guarding and critique-guided supervision.

keywords.name: Flow matching
keywords.about: Flow-matching generators handle sequential reasoning, constrained sampling and gigapixel slide synthesis, and guide pixel diffusion transformers.

top_papers.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
top_papers.authors: Mingyu Ouyang, Yiran Wang, Siyuan Hu et al.
top_papers.why: Proposes a scalable post-training framework using synthetic environments and PPO to teach game control to computer-use agents, demonstrating a viable path beyond demonstration-based learning.
top_papers.key_result: Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively, and Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld.
evidence: The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld.

On MineDojo-300, Player-1-9B improves from 10.54% success after SFT to 38.33%, exceeding the strongest evaluated external baseline at 12.63% under our evaluation protocol. The same policy also improves on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld, both outside the RL training suite.

We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience advances game-control capabilities beyond supervised demonstrations: Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B gain 27.8 and 17.7 pp in MineDojo-300 success, respectively, with further gains on ViZDoom and GameWorld outside the RL training suite.

news.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
news.summary: Itaú described ia.i, a conversational interface, and IARA, a governance and orchestration platform, as part of its AI First strategy. The first phase covers ~300,000 customers, with a goal of 100% of the customer base by the end of 2026; the text also cites 90M+ documents in a legal solution repository and 20% to 80% efficiency gains in department processes.

news.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
news.summary: Stack Overflow for Agents, built by two engineers in a few weeks with Codex, saw signups triple overnight after a ChatGPT plugin, with up to 10× more agents created. The text also reports an 87% maximum reduction in connector build time, from 3–6 weeks to 4 days.

news.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
news.summary: OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs up to 30 Business Standard seats at $0 per user per month for up to 12 months and access to GPT-Rosalind subject to trusted-access approval. GPT-Rosalind is described as a dedicated life sciences model combined with the Rosalind workbench.

news.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
news.summary: OpenAI launched the AI for Educators course in Brazilian Portuguese on OpenAI Academy and described Study Mode, which guides users step by step with questions, hints, explanations, and checks for understanding. The course is for primary, secondary, and higher education educators and covers lesson planning, activities, assessments, and communications.

news.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind published a technical walkthrough in which biologists used its agentic development platform Google Antigravity, together with the ProtNLM model that predicts biological function from amino acid sequences, to uncover a novel antimicrobial peptide candidate with predicted activity against respiratory tract infection pathogens; the lead is now undergoing wet-lab validation. The post cites an estimated 10 million annual global deaths from antimicrobial resistance by 2050 and names a candidate bacteriocin (UniProt ID A0A0U0D591).

news.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
news.summary: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore fine-tuned Google's lightweight Gemma model on local scam conversations to build a privacy-preserving, on-device scam detection model, presented at Singapore International Cyber Week (SICW 2026). The text states scams make up over half of Singapore's reported crimes and more than S$4 billion in losses since 2019, with such scams accounting for up to 80% of all losses; the two-stage pipeline runs a lightweight classifier followed by in-context analysis with the fine-tuned Gemma model.

news.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
news.summary: Google DeepMind published its safety and security approach for Gemini 4 Argon, which it says solved all 12 end-to-end simulated cyberattack scenarios versus five for the previous generation, with adversarial-set violations reduced nearly twofold. It describes three layers of real-time protection (input screening, internal introspection via activation probes, and continuous monitoring) and cites Wiz using Argon to uncover a critical bug in hospital software affecting hundreds of thousands of patient records, with the Fairwind Program expanding to more trusted cyber defenders.

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
news.summary: Google DeepMind reports Gemini 4 Argon scores 87% on the Embodied Reasoning (ERQA) benchmark, outperforming other frontier models using pure reasoning. The post lists robotics prompts including controlling a Boston Dynamics Spot (12-DoF legs + 6-DoF arm), retargeting human video onto a 76-DoF bimanual humanoid with 22-DoF five-fingered hands, arranging five Scrabble tiles (G, R, A, N, O), and verifying 6/6 target knockdown in a mujoco_warp scene exported as a Blender 4.5 Cycles render.

news.title: Grounding AI agents in biological reality: Building blocks for autonomous wet labs
news.summary: Google Research described VERID, a semantic digital twin of a wet-lab workcell built on PyLabRobot that lets AI agents plan, simulate, and execute liquid-handling protocols with live 3D state tracking, virtual dry runs, hardware safety checks, and synchronized video/action logs. The post also reports closed-loop molecular design cycles discovering single-digit nanomolar protein binders for cancer targets.

news.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
news.summary: Google Research published a technical report on its Geospatial Reasoning agent, presenting systematic evaluations across four benchmarks including two new ones, GeoKTools and GeoExpertQueries. Partner testing involved the WHO Regional Office for Africa, People in Need, GiveDirectly, the Milken Institute and WPP for workflows such as disease outbreak investigations, disaster preparedness and clean energy screening, and early access is expanding via an experimental deep research update for Ask Google Earth and an agent-to-agent API.

news.title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
news.summary: Google Research publicly released Deep Review, an agentic system for technical verification of documents, after deployments across 16,000+ opt-in submissions at STOC 2026, ICML 2026, NeurIPS 2026 and ICLR 2027. Every user receives two complimentary document reviews per week, with higher limits and API access via a Gemini API key; initial input support covers PDFs and plain text, and uploaded documents are stored for one year and never used to train, fine-tune or improve Google models. The post cites over 74,000 submissions to ICLR, NeurIPS and ICML this year, up from approximately 45,000 in 2025, 32,000 in 2024 and 23,000 in 2023.

news.title: Research@ 2026: 10 ways we're amplifying human ingenuity
news.summary: At its Research@ event, Google Research listed 10 highlights including expanded early access to Google Earth AI, integration of Google Dataset Search for querying more than 100 million public datasets, and capabilities powered by over 70 geospatial tools. Google.org is providing $10 million in funding for crisis resilience and public health, including $2 million to The Milken Institute, and a multi-agent orchestrator helped researchers apply a fluid-mechanics inverse design methodology to urinary catheter designs that in simulation were better at preventing bacterial infections.

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
news.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Argon globally available for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and the Gemini platform, for AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and for Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens with cached input at 95% off, and ranking #1 on the Vals Index. The post reports Argon in Antigravity increased agentic code submissions by more than 35% while reducing code rollbacks by nearly a third, along with a Chrome refactor across hundreds of files, a 40% cut in ADK session prep time and 21% faster cold imports, xTB speedups of up to 2.3x and 1.8x, and a 2.85x Gemma 4 E2B inference speedup on an A100 via vLLM.

news.title: Anthropic update on independent evaluators
news.summary: Anthropic said it has onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space and access to internal tools and systems roughly on par with its own risk assessment teams, and that METR will publish its risk assessments without Anthropic being able to veto publication (Anthropic can require redaction only in narrow predefined categories). Anthropic also said it is working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators and is in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

news.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
news.summary: Anthropic described election safeguards ahead of the 2026 US midterms, based on an Anthropic Insights analysis of 250,000 conversations over a one-week period; in US Claude.ai conversations, politics/public policy/social issues accounted for about 5.75%, elections or voting about 0.51%, requests for whom or what to vote for about 0.01%, and election integrity policy violations about 0.002%. Claude will draw official voting information from Democracy Works for US users and show up-to-date election results, alongside the existing TurboVote banner.

news.title: Singapore office and government MOU
news.summary: Anthropic opened a Singapore office, its fifth in the Asia-Pacific region, and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Singapore Ministry of Digital Development and Information covering AI safety, security, model evaluation, AI adoption research and responsible adoption. The post states Singapore ranks second of 121 countries in Claude.ai usage relative to population, at nearly six times what its size alone would predict, and that more than 1,500 engineers and technical staff at GovTech Singapore have adopted Claude Code.

news.title: Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Magnetar, a zero-knowledge proof system that proves programs written in Rust, Go or C, runs 10 to 39 times faster on average than the prior fastest comparable systems, and bases security only on standard hash functions. Microsoft said its Quantum Safe Program will move its products and services to post-quantum cryptography, a goal it recently accelerated to 2029.

news.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced StudentSim, a research system that trains personalized AI student simulators from publicly available, de-identified learner records to evaluate and improve AI tutors before testing with real learners. It introduces StudentSimEval across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, and reports that StudentSim outperforms leading baselines.

news.title: Be There for the Beginning: Celebrate the Launch of NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA announced launch celebrations for RTX Spark on Friday, Oct. 16, at events in San Francisco, Berlin, Taipei, Beijing, Istanbul and Seoul, plus a #ShareYourSpark campaign offering an ASUS ProArt P14 RTX Spark laptop signed by Jensen Huang. The post quotes reviewer comments and cites independent testing from Artificial Analysis.

news.title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
news.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model it says delivers up to 5x faster throughput than the next best in its class and accuracy comparable to NVIDIA's largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. Two edge models join it: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, available now using native 2-bit quantization to fit in 24GB, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, coming Oct. 23.

news.title: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA added DLSS 4.5 controls to GeForce NOW, including DLSS Super Resolution, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation (up to 4X for Ultimate members on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs) and Ray Reconstruction, alongside 10 new games joining the service this week. Enshrouded left early access with its 1.0 release, skipping a 60GB local install, and raised the player level cap to 50 and equipment cap to 55 with nine new spells; Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 also began streaming at launch.

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute
news.summary: At the AI in Science Summit in Dublin, the European Commission launched the AI in Science Enablers Initiative connected to RAISE, with NVIDIA pledging accelerated tools and platforms, compute and cloud resources, skills training, collaborative projects and startup support. NVIDIA cited more than 250 open models, 250 open datasets and over 1,400 open source projects, a new NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open source courseware hub, and compute collaborations with European national AI factories including in France, Spain and Sweden, where AI2F in France was the first AI factory to work with the Inception program for four months.

news.title: Code, Test, and Deploy on One Machine with NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA announced RTX Spark, combining the GB10 system-on-a-chip with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of FP4 AI compute for local coding agents, testing, and deployment on one PC. The post cites 4.6x faster coding-agent performance, 2.7x faster fine-tuning, and 1.8x faster code compilation versus Intel Panther Lake 12Xe, and introduces Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, a 74B-parameter mixture-of-experts model quantized to 2 bits.

news.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
news.summary: NVIDIA described Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 12B parameters per token and delivers up to 5x higher throughput on a single GPU, with over 600 TPS on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index agentic tasks on the Baseten endpoint. It said organizations including Scale AI, Ramp and AI21 have post-trained the model, reporting gains such as 40x lower inference cost, 10x lower latency and 40% higher accuracy, and that developers can customize it with NVIDIA NeMo using supervised fine-tuning, low-rank adaptation and reinforcement learning.

news.title: Scale Agentic Coding Workflows with Meta’s Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
news.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 42B parameters per token through top-8 routing across 256 experts with a 1M token context window, was trained on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Blackwell Ultra and runs agentic workloads at up to 50K tokens per second per GPU and up to 600 tokens per second per user. The model includes a 1.8B perception encoder for interleaved text, images, video frames and audio, and NVFP4 checkpoints optimized for Blackwell Ultra are available on Hugging Face.

news.title: Optimizing Agent Reliability and Tool Calling Efficiency for Chip Design Using NVIDIA NeMo Gym
news.summary: NVIDIA describes how Siemens EDA used the NeMo Gym agentic evaluation environment to improve the Siemens Fuse EDA AI Agent for Liberty file generation in standard-cell characterization, increasing the composite verification score from approximately 55% to ~95% while cutting agent turns by 66%. Agent turns decreased from 155 to 53 and output tokens fell from approximately 81K to 29K after refining skills and Model Context Protocol tool descriptions based on verifier diagnostics; a domain-specific verifier assigns zero reward if any of its five gates fails.

news.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
news.summary: NVIDIA and AI4Bharat released Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1, about 2.8 trillion tokens across 22 Indian languages, with native-script data for all 22 and romanized text for twelve across 34 language-script configurations. The corpus contains 2,601.0 billion native-script tokens and 224.6 billion romanized tokens, and continued pretraining for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL added 10 billion Indic tokens from a twelve-language subset.

news.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
news.summary: Reflection released Beam on Hugging Face, a 501B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 23B active parameters per token, a 1M-token context window, and an Apache 2.0 license. The model has 52 layers, 256 experts per MoE layer with 8 routed per token, checkpoint formats BF16/FP8/NVFP4, and comes with a Rust-based harness plus $10,000 in Hub credits for selected projects.

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
news.summary: The Granite Switch 4.1 release comprises 8B and 30B models configured with a new Decision aLoRA for general-purpose decisions, a Guardian aLoRA that on average outperforms Jev 1.13, Microsoft-Decision-1, GPT-Luna-Decisions and Clef-Flash on safety-related decision tasks, and Granite-Speech-5.0-Turbo-CTC, described as the fastest ASR model on the OpenASR Leaderboard, composed into one model using about the same VRAM as the base model. A 3B Granite Switch model was reported to make 60-100 decisions per second in Doom versus Jev's reported 10 decisions per second, and Granite-Switch-4.1-30B completed a five-step RAG workflow faster than Jev-27B.

news.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
news.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open on Hugging Face, an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model with approximately 816B total parameters, around 42B active per token, and a context window up to 1M tokens. It accepts text, images, audio, and video and outputs text, uses 256 experts per MoE layer with 8 selected per token, and ships in BF16 and NVFP4 checkpoint formats.

news.title: Local and Distributed Large LLM Inference with MLX and RDMA on Mac Studio
news.summary: Apple described running Muse Spark Open, a nearly trillion-parameter model, on a cluster of four Mac Studios using MLX and RDMA over Thunderbolt, generating over 36 tokens per second at a context size of 8,192 tokens. The post benchmarks Muse Spark Open (816B), Mistral Medium 3.5 (128B), and Qwen 3.8 (27B) on M5 Ultra and M3 Ultra Mac Studios, with up to 512GB unified memory.

news.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
news.summary: Apple researchers introduced Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), which reformulates multimodal agent reasoning as selection among pre-specified natural-language candidates rather than open-ended generation. Evaluated on seven multimodal search benchmarks with 2B and 4B models, SSR reduced per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question inference latency by 28–54% while maintaining competitive success rates.

news.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
news.summary: Apple researchers compared Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP) and Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) for tool discovery on ToolBench, which has 46,984 unique API endpoints across 50 categories, and found a complexity-dependent crossover: RtP wins on single-tool queries while PtR wins on multi-tool queries. The crossover held across retrieval budgets k=1 to 20 and registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, with PtR’s extra discovery call roughly doubling inference cost.

news.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
news.summary: Apple researchers proposed a lightweight method to detect code-switching directly from speech by identifying language-selective hidden-state dimensions in pretrained speech encoders and aggregating frame-level activations. On CS-FLEURS across 14 language pairs, the Whisper-small encoder achieved a mean F1 of 0.798, compared with 0.776 for a CNN and 0.751 for a HuBERT linear baseline.

news.title: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS described a production evaluation framework using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for a multi-agent sales system, after pre-launch evaluation of its Customer Insights Agent surfaced errors such as reporting $410.08 as '$410.08 Million' while monitoring stayed green. The post also reports that in one pre-production test a mismatch window dropped the pass rate from 78 percent to 38 percent.

news.title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
news.summary: AWS described deploying Reflection’s open-weight Beam model, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active parameters, for agentic coding on Amazon SageMaker. Beam has an effective context length of 1 million tokens, Apache 2.0 weights in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4, and is available at launch in SageMaker JumpStart in US East (N. Virginia) and US East (Ohio).

news.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
news.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter MoE model with 42B active parameters, a 1M token context window and text, image, document, audio and audio-video input, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart in BF16 (Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B) and NVFP4 quantized (Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4) variants. The post says the NVFP4 variant runs on ml.p5e.48xlarge and the BF16 variant on ml.p6-b300.48xlarge, with weights released under the Muse Model License including the Muse Spark Usage Policy.

news.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
news.summary: AWS described "Trust in Depth," an approach that combines automated reasoning with content filtering, testing and monitoring so agents can act autonomously where their rules can be precisely stated and proven, organized around scope, know, bound and observe questions across the agent lifecycle. AWS said it has run automated reasoning in production for more than a decade, including in IAM at more than 2.1 billion requests per second, and is now bringing it to agents.

en.editorial: This week 2,725 papers appeared, down from 4,528 the previous week. LLM reasoning, reinforcement learning, and test-time scaling rose to 87 papers (up 1.46 per 1k), diffusion, flow matching, and 3D reconstruction rose to 65 (up 1.27), and safety, adversarial robustness, and interpretability rose to 9 (up 1.36); time-series, tabular, graph, and physics-informed models fell to 12. Among the most-read papers, Waypoint-OPD led with 654 upvotes, followed by Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation and Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience, with 341 and 332. Also notable are DiffusionART, S-Space, and Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision. Releases such as Gemini 4 Argon, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, and Meta's Muse Spark Open may shape next week's work.

top_papers.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
top_papers.authors: Weijie Wang, Haomin Zhang, Ye Li et al.
top_papers.why: 引入了一种世界状态记忆框架，大幅提升了智能体视频生成中的跨镜头空间和时间一致性，并在多个生成器上取得了显著的实证收益。
top_papers.key_result: 在四个视频生成器上，ATAS 改善了所有报告的跨镜头一致性指标，并在每个骨干网络上取得了最高的聚合基准分数；同时，在目标图像空间重访方面，它也优于所比较的 agent 和 3D 引导方法，达到 15.968 PSNR_C、0.385 SSIM_C 和 0.284 LPIPS_C。它在三项事件重捕标准上领先——事件身份（0.750）、时间顺序（0.688）和视角实现（0.650）——并且在全部六项标准上获得了最高的人类评价。
evidence: Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone.
It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria.

ATAS reaches 15.968 PSNR_C, 0.385 SSIM_C, and 0.284 LPIPS_C, outperforming the compared multi-shot and 3D-guided methods (Tab. ). In Tab. , it leads event identity (0.750), temporal order (0.688), and viewpoint realization (0.650), ties ReCA on character and object consistency (0.917), and remains slightly lower on action-state preservation (0.688 versus 0.700).

top_papers.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
top_papers.authors: Mingyu Ouyang, Yiran Wang, Siyuan Hu et al.
top_papers.why: 提出了一种可扩展的后训练框架，利用合成环境和 PPO 教会计算机使用智能体进行游戏控制，展示了一条超越基于示范学习的可行路径。
top_papers.key_result: Player-1-9B 和 Player-1-35B-A3B 相对于其 SFT 策略，在 MineDojo-300 上的成功率分别提高了 27.8 和 17.7 个百分点；Player-1-9B 的成功率达到 38.33%，而最强评估基线的成功率为 12.63%；此外，在 ViZDoom-10 和 GameWorld 上还相较 SFT 有进一步提升。
evidence: The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld.

On MineDojo-300, Player-1-9B improves from 10.54% success after SFT to 38.33%, exceeding the strongest evaluated external baseline at 12.63% under our evaluation protocol. The same policy also improves on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld, both outside the RL training suite.

We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience advances game-control capabilities beyond supervised demonstrations: Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B gain 27.8 and 17.7 pp in MineDojo-300 success, respectively, with further gains on ViZDoom and GameWorld outside the RL training suite.

news.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了一份技术讲解，生物学家使用其智能体开发平台 Google Antigravity，以及从氨基酸序列预测生物学功能的 ProtNLM 模型，发现了一种新型抗菌肽候选物，其预测对呼吸道感染病原体具有活性；该先导物目前正在进行湿实验验证。文章引用估计到 2050 年，全球每年因抗微生物药物耐药性死亡人数为 10 million，并指出一种候选细菌素（UniProt ID A0A0U0D591）。

news.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection

news.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
news.summary: Google DeepMind published its safety and security approach for Gemini 4 Argon, which it says solved all 12 end-to-end simulated cyberattack scenarios versus five for the previous generation, with adversarial-set violations reduced nearly twofold. It describes three layers of real-time protection (input screening, internal introspection via activation probes, and continuous monitoring) and cites Wiz using Argon to uncover a critical bug in hospital software affecting hundreds of thousands of patient records, with the Fairwind Program expanding to more trusted cyber defenders.

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
news.summary: Google DeepMind reports Gemini 4 Argon scores 87% on the Embodied Reasoning (ERQA) benchmark, outperforming other frontier models using pure reasoning. The post lists robotics prompts including controlling a Boston Dynamics Spot (12-DoF legs + 6-DoF arm), retargeting human video onto a 76-DoF bimanual humanoid with 22-DoF five-fingered hands, arranging five Scrabble tiles (G, R, A, N, O), and verifying 6/6 target knockdown in a mujoco_warp scene exported as a Blender 4.5 Cycles render.

news.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
news.summary: Google Research published a technical report on its Geospatial Reasoning agent, presenting systematic evaluations across four benchmarks including two new ones, GeoKTools and GeoExpertQueries. Partner testing involved the WHO Regional Office for Africa, People in Need, GiveDirectly, the Milken Institute and WPP for workflows such as disease outbreak investigations, disaster preparedness and clean energy screening, and early access is expanding via an experimental deep research update for Ask Google Earth and an agent-to-agent API.

news.title: Analyzing technical documents with Deep Review
news.summary: Google Research 公开发布了 Deep Review，一个用于文档技术验证的智能体系统，此前已在 STOC 2026、ICML 2026、NeurIPS 2026 和 ICLR 2027 的 16,000+ 份自愿提交中部署。每位用户每周可免费获得两次文档评审，通过 Gemini API 密钥可获得更高额度和 API 访问权限；初始输入支持 PDF 和纯文本，上传的文档将存储一年，且绝不会用于训练、微调或改进 Google 模型。文章指出今年 ICLR、NeurIPS 和 ICML 的投稿超过 74,000 份，高于 2025 年的约 45,000 份、2024 年的 32,000 份和 2023 年的 23,000 份。

news.title: Research@ 2026: 10 ways we're amplifying human ingenuity
news.summary: 在其 Research@ 活动中，Google Research 列出了 10 项亮点，包括扩大 Google Earth AI 的早期访问、集成 Google Dataset Search 以查询超过 100 million 个公共数据集，以及由超过 70 个地理空间工具提供支持的功能。Google.org 提供 $10 million 资金用于危机韧性和公共卫生，其中 $2 million 提供给 The Milken Institute；一个多智能体编排器帮助研究人员将流体力学逆向设计方法应用于导尿管设计，模拟显示这些设计在预防细菌感染方面更有效。

news.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
news.summary: Google 通过 AI Studio 和 Gemini 平台的 API 向开发者和企业全面提供 Gemini 4 Argon，Google Antigravity 中的 AI Ultra 订阅用户、Gemini 应用和搜索 AI 模式中的 Ultra 和 Pro 订阅用户也可以使用；定价为每 1 million 输入 token $2、每 1 million 输出 token $10，缓存输入可享受 95% 折扣，并在 Vals Index 上排名第 1。文章报告称 Antigravity 中的 Argon 将智能体代码提交量提高了超过 35%，同时将代码回滚减少了近三分之一；此外还包括对数百个文件的 Chrome 重构、ADK 会话准备时间缩短 40%、冷导入速度提高 21%、xTB 加速最高达到 2.3x 和 1.8x，以及通过 vLLM 在 A100 上实现 Gemma 4 E2B 推理加速 2.85x。

news.title: Anthropic update on independent evaluators
news.summary: Anthropic said it has onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space and access to internal tools and systems roughly on par with its own risk assessment teams, and that METR will publish its risk assessments without Anthropic being able to veto publication (Anthropic can require redaction only in narrow predefined categories). Anthropic also said it is working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators and is in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

news.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
news.summary: Anthropic 在 2026 年美国中期选举前描述了选举保护措施，基于 Anthropic Insights 对一周内 250,000 次对话的分析；在美国 Claude.ai 对话中，政治/公共政策/社会议题约占 5.75%，选举或投票约占 0.51%，询问投票给谁或什么的请求约占 0.01%，选举诚信政策违规约占 0.002%。Claude 将为美国用户从 Democracy Works 获取官方投票信息，并展示最新选举结果，同时保留现有的 TurboVote 横幅。

news.title: Singapore office and government MOU
news.summary: Anthropic 在新加坡开设了办事处，这是其在亚太地区的第五个办事处，并与新加坡数字发展与信息部签署了谅解备忘录，涵盖 AI 安全、安全、模型评估、AI 采用研究和负责任采用。文章称新加坡在 121 个国家中 Claude.ai 使用量相对于人口排名第二，几乎是其规模单独预测的六倍，且新加坡 GovTech 有超过 1,500 名工程师和技术人员采用了 Claude Code。

news.title: Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar
news.summary: 微软研究院推出了 Magnetar，一种零知识证明系统，可证明用 Rust、Go 或 C 编写的程序，平均运行速度比之前最快的同类系统快 10 到 39 倍，且其安全性仅基于标准哈希函数。微软表示其 Quantum Safe Program 将把其产品和服务迁移到后量子密码学，该目标最近加速至 2029 年。

news.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
news.summary: 微软研究院推出了 StudentSim，一种研究系统，从公开可用的去标识化学习者记录中训练个性化 AI 学生模拟器，以便在与真实学习者测试前评估和改进 AI 导师。它推出了 StudentSimEval，涵盖国际象棋、第二语言英语写作和数学，并报告 StudentSim 优于领先的基线。

news.title: Be There for the Beginning: Celebrate the Launch of NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA announced launch celebrations for RTX Spark on Friday, Oct. 16, at events in San Francisco, Berlin, Taipei, Beijing, Istanbul and Seoul, plus a #ShareYourSpark campaign offering an ASUS ProArt P14 RTX Spark laptop signed by Jensen Huang. The post quotes reviewer comments and cites independent testing from Artificial Analysis.

news.title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
news.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model it says delivers up to 5x faster throughput than the next best in its class and accuracy comparable to NVIDIA's largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. Two edge models join it: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, available now using native 2-bit quantization to fit in 24GB, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, coming Oct. 23.

news.title: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA 为 GeForce NOW 添加了 DLSS 4.5 控制，包括 DLSS 超分辨率、动态多帧生成（Ultimate 会员在 GeForce RTX 5080 驱动的云设备上最高可达 4X）和光线重建，同时本周有 10 款新游戏加入该服务。Enshrouded 以 1.0 版本离开抢先体验，跳过了 60GB 本地安装，将玩家等级上限提升至 50，装备上限提升至 55，并新增九个法术；Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 也在发布时开始流式传输。

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute
news.summary: 在都柏林举行的 AI in Science Summit 上，欧盟委员会启动了与 RAISE 相连接的 AI in Science Enablers Initiative，NVIDIA 承诺提供加速工具和平台、计算和云资源、技能培训、合作项目和初创企业支持。NVIDIA 引用了超过 250 个开放模型、250 个开放数据集和超过 1,400 个开源项目，一个新的 NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute 开源课件中心，以及与包括法国、西班牙和瑞典在内的欧洲国家 AI 工厂的计算合作，其中法国的 AI2F 是第一家与 Inception 项目合作四个月的 AI 工厂。

news.title: Code, Test, and Deploy on One Machine with NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 RTX Spark，将 GB10 系统级芯片与最高 128GB 统一内存和 1 petaflop FP4 AI 计算相结合，用于在一台 PC 上本地运行编码智能体、测试和部署。文章称与 Intel Panther Lake 12Xe 相比，编码智能体性能快 4.6 倍，微调快 2.7 倍，代码编译快 1.8 倍，并推出了 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB，一个量化到 2 位的 74B 参数混合专家模型。

news.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，一个开放的 120B 参数混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 12B 参数，在单个 GPU 上可提供最高 5 倍吞吐量，在 Baseten 端点上 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 智能体任务中超过 600 TPS。NVIDIA 表示包括 Scale AI、Ramp 和 AI21 在内的组织已对该模型进行后训练，报告了推理成本降低 40 倍、延迟降低 10 倍、准确率提高 40% 等收益；开发者可以使用 NVIDIA NeMo 通过监督微调、低秩适应和强化学习进行定制。

news.title: Scale Agentic Coding Workflows with Meta’s Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
news.summary: Meta 的 Muse Spark Open 是一个 816B 参数混合专家模型，通过 256 个专家中的 top-8 路由为每个 token 激活 42B 参数，上下文窗口为 1M token，在 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Blackwell Ultra 上训练，并在每个 GPU 上以最高 50K tokens/秒、每个用户最高 600 tokens/秒运行智能体工作负载。该模型包含一个 1.8B 感知编码器，用于交错文本、图像、视频帧和音频，针对 Blackwell Ultra 优化的 NVFP4 检查点已在 Hugging Face 上提供。

news.title: Optimizing Agent Reliability and Tool Calling Efficiency for Chip Design Using NVIDIA NeMo Gym
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了 Siemens EDA 如何使用 NeMo Gym 智能体评估环境改进用于标准单元表征中 Liberty 文件生成的 Siemens Fuse EDA AI Agent，将综合验证分数从约 55% 提高到约 95%，同时将智能体轮次减少 66%。在根据验证器诊断优化技能和 Model Context Protocol 工具描述后，智能体轮次从 155 降至 53，输出 token 从约 81K 降至 29K；域特定验证器在其五个门中的任何一个失败时给出零奖励。

news.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
news.summary: NVIDIA and AI4Bharat released Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1, about 2.8 trillion tokens across 22 Indian languages, with native-script data for all 22 and romanized text for twelve across 34 language-script configurations. The corpus contains 2,601.0 billion native-script tokens and 224.6 billion romanized tokens, and continued pretraining for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL added 10 billion Indic tokens from a twelve-language subset.

news.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
news.summary: Reflection 在 Hugging Face 上发布了 Beam，一个 501B 参数混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 23B 参数，上下文窗口为 1M token，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。该模型有 52 层，每个 MoE 层有 256 个专家，每个 token 路由 8 个专家，检查点格式包括 BF16/FP8/NVFP4，并带有基于 Rust 的框架，以及为选定项目提供的 $10,000 Hub 积分。

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
news.summary: Granite Switch 4.1 版本由 8B 和 30B 模型组成，配置了新的 Decision aLoRA 用于通用决策，一个 Guardian aLoRA 在安全相关决策任务上平均优于 Jev 1.13、Microsoft-Decision-1、GPT-Luna-Decisions 和 Clef-Flash，以及 Granite-Speech-5.0-Turbo-CTC，被称为 OpenASR Leaderboard 上最快的 ASR 模型，组合成一个模型，所需 VRAM 与基础模型大致相同。据报道，一个 3B Granite Switch 模型在 Doom 中每秒做出 60-100 次决策，而 Jev 报告为每秒 10 次决策；Granite-Switch-4.1-30B 完成五步 RAG 工作流的速度快于 Jev-27B。

news.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
news.summary: Meta 在 Hugging Face 上发布了 Muse Spark Open，一个开放权重多模态混合专家模型，总参数约 816B，每个 token 激活约 42B，上下文窗口最高 1M token。它接受文本、图像、音频和视频输入，输出文本，每个 MoE 层使用 256 个专家，每个 token 选择 8 个专家，提供 BF16 和 NVFP4 检查点格式。

news.title: Local and Distributed Large LLM Inference with MLX and RDMA on Mac Studio
news.summary: Apple 描述了在由四台 Mac Studio 组成的集群上运行 Muse Spark Open（一个近 trillion-parameter 模型），使用 MLX 和 Thunderbolt 上的 RDMA，在上下文大小为 8,192 token 时生成超过 36 tokens/秒。文章在 M5 Ultra 和 M3 Ultra Mac Studio 上对 Muse Spark Open (816B)、Mistral Medium 3.5 (128B) 和 Qwen 3.8 (27B) 进行了基准测试，统一内存最高 512GB。

news.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
news.summary: Apple 研究人员提出了基于选择的结构化推理（SSR），将多模态智能体推理重新表述为在预先指定的自然语言候选项中进行选择，而不是开放式生成。在七个多模态搜索基准上使用 2B 和 4B 模型评估，SSR 将每轮推理延迟降低了超过 90%，将每个问题的总推理延迟降低了 28–54%，同时保持了有竞争力的成功率。

news.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
news.summary: Apple 研究人员比较了 Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP) 和 Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) 在 ToolBench 上的工具发现，ToolBench 有 46,984 个唯一 API 端点，覆盖 50 个类别，并发现了一个复杂度相关的交叉点：RtP 在单工具查询中获胜，而 PtR 在多工具查询中获胜。该交叉在检索预算 k=1 到 20 以及注册表大小从 1k 到 47k 个 API 的范围内都成立，PtR 的额外发现调用使推理成本大约翻倍。

news.title: Code-Switching Detection via Language-Selective Dimensions in Speech Foundation Models
news.summary: Apple 研究人员提出了一种轻量级方法，通过识别预训练语音编码器中的语言选择性隐状态维度并聚合帧级激活，直接从语音中检测语码转换。在 CS-FLEURS 的 14 个语言对上，Whisper-small 编码器实现了 0.798 的平均 F1，而 CNN 为 0.776，HuBERT 线性基线为 0.751。

news.title: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS 描述了一个使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 的多智能体销售系统的生产评估框架，此前对 Customer Insights Agent 的发布前评估发现了一些错误，例如将 $410.08 报告为“$410.08 Million”，而监控仍显示正常。文章还报告在一次预生产测试中，一个不匹配窗口使通过率从 78% 下降到 38%。

news.title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
news.summary: AWS 描述了在 Amazon SageMaker 上部署 Reflection 的开放权重 Beam 模型，用于智能体编码，该模型是一个稀疏混合专家模型，总参数 501 billion，激活参数 23 billion。Beam 的有效上下文长度为 1 million token，提供 Apache 2.0 权重的 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 格式，并在上线时于 SageMaker JumpStart 的美国东部（弗吉尼亚北部）和美国东部（俄亥俄）区域提供。

news.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
news.summary: Meta 的 Muse Spark Open 是一个 816B 参数 MoE 模型，激活参数 42B，上下文窗口 1M token，支持文本、图像、文档、音频和音频视频输入，现已在 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart 中提供 BF16（Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B）和 NVFP4 量化（Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4）两种版本。文章称 NVFP4 版本运行在 ml.p5e.48xlarge 上，BF16 版本运行在 ml.p6-b300.48xlarge 上，权重在 Muse Model License（包括 Muse Spark Usage Policy）下发布。

news.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
news.summary: AWS 描述了“Trust in Depth”（深度信任）方法，将自动推理与内容过滤、测试和监控相结合，使智能体能够在规则可以被精确陈述和证明的范围内自主行动，围绕智能体生命周期中的范围、知道、约束和观察问题来组织。AWS 表示其在生产环境中运行自动推理已有十多年，包括在 IAM 中每秒处理超过 2.1 billion 次请求，现在正将其引入智能体。
